images.title: Four cards, three sign switches
images.purpose: Shows the sign flip board in its simplest state: four number cards, a sign switch in each gap, and the result with its parity.
images.composition: Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no characters, no extra text. One row of four large cards across the centre with a round switch in each gap, and a result box at the right end.
images.exact_structure: Four equal white rectangular cards with thin dark outlines in one row, holding 3, 4, 5 and 6. In each of the three gaps, one round toggle switch: the first switch is green (#009E73) and shows +, the second and third are vermilion (#D55E00) and show −. At the right end, after the card 6, a reddish purple (#CC79A7) rounded box holding = −4. Under the box, a small reddish purple (#CC79A7) tag holding even. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Each gap holds a plus or minus switch, and the result 3 + 4 − 5 − 6 = −4 is even.
